rationale: Trip Cancellation and Interruption (wording section 2) pays only for the five reasons listed there, and the wording says "We do not pay for cancellation or interruption for any other reason." Your son was unharmed and needed no medical care, so this is not sickness, injury or death of a family member, and no other listed reason applies. The unused hotel nights and the one-way fare home are therefore not payable, although we are very glad Kevin was fine.
